heroHeadline: 3 Days to Provisional Squad Deadline — Mbappé Hamstring Concern; TelevisaUnivision Inks Spanish Radio Deal; 34 Days to Kickoff
heroSubtitle: With the FIFA provisional squad deadline (May 11) just three days away, all 48 nations are finalizing their 35–55 player preliminary lists. Key squad announcement dates: France on May 14 (Deschamps; Hugo Ekitike confirmed out with Achilles); Brazil on May 18 (Ancelotti; Rodrygo and Militão confirmed absent, Estevao in doubt); Germany on May 21; USMNT on May 26 at a live NYC event on FOX Sports. Lionel Messi is among 21 players Scaloni has confirmed in Argentina's plans — the preliminary squad is due today (May 11 deadline). A pre-tournament injury concern emerged for France captain Kylian Mbappé (hamstring), with Deschamps expected to monitor his status before naming the squad on May 14; Mbappé is projected to return for El Clásico on May 10. On the Iran participation front, FIFA's May 20 Zurich meeting with Iran FA president Mehdi Taj remains the last formal diplomatic channel before the June 1 final squad submission deadline — Taj's demand for guarantees that IRGC-linked personnel will not be questioned remains structurally impossible under US law, and Secretary of State Rubio has categorically refused any IRGC admissions. TelevisaUnivision and Fútbol de Primera announced an exclusive Spanish-language radio partnership on May 8 covering World Cup 2026 matches in New York, Dallas, Houston, and Chicago — the largest Spanish-language radio footprint for a World Cup in US history. 34 days to kickoff at Estadio Azteca.
